description:
Analyze the packet capture ~/Documents/captures/200722_tcp_anon.pcapng to identify TCP latency spikes. Configure Wireshark to calculate TCP conversation timestamps (if not already enabled). Apply a display filter to find packets where the time since the previous packet in the same stream (tcp.time_delta) is greater than 0.2 seconds.

1. Export these specific 'laggy' packets to a new file named ~/Documents/captures/latency_spikes.pcapng.
2. Create a report file at ~/Documents/captures/latency_report.txt containing:
   - total_spike_packets: <number of packets matching the filter>
   - worst_stream_index: <tcp.stream index of the packet with the highest delta>
   - max_delta_seconds: <the maximum time delta value in seconds>

Format the report as key: value pairs.
